name: Scenes as evidence
summary: A scene is an interaction written down - keys pressed, screens expected - run on every change; its screens are kept as evidence a person can look at.
why: An interactive tool should be proven like any other: by a machine, every time.

name: Two doors
summary: Every tool keeps an interactive door for people and a structured door - plain arguments, readable output - for agents and scripts. The driver is for checking the interactive door, not for everyday use.
why: An agent pressing keys on a screen is slow and brittle; a structured door is neither. argenv's own idea - one setting, two doors - applied to whole tools.
